GENRA CHOP 2.4.0 – a hip-hop beat generator for VCV Rack 2 with four modules: **GENRA CHOP**, **GENRA CHOP GRID**, **GENRA CHOP ABLAUF** and **GENRA CHOP FX**.

### New in 2.4.0
- **WARP**: fit the sample to the tempo of the beat (AUTO / BEATS / TONE, Rubber Band R3 or Signalsmith Stretch)
- **SAMPLE** plays the whole sample, **CLEAR** per track, pads in MPC order, new drum order with style-typical DENS extras, NEW ALL cuts fresh
- **GRID** records from GENRA CHOP's MIDI input when it has none of its own
- **FX** now 36 HP: eight sources in and out on their own jacks, returns and mix out, DJ pads, DJ filter, small screens above the controls, LOW CUT and HIGH CUT
- **ABLAUF**: drag pads into the song list, move rows by dragging, scroll bar

Full history: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Camillowup/Genra-Chop/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) (German), manual: [README.md](https://github.com/Camillowup/Genra-Chop/blob/main/README.md)

### Downloads
- `…-win-x64.vcvplugin` – Windows
- `…-mac-x64.vcvplugin` – Mac with Intel processor

The Mac build for Apple silicon (M1 and later) will follow.

Install: put the `.vcvplugin` file into Rack's `plugins` folder (Rack › Help › Open user folder) and restart Rack.
